kernel.governing_law: The figure claims absolute authority over the hearer: it is the inner become outer, the origin become messenger, the knower become teacher — every relation is vertical (I teach/you learn, I come from above/you are below, I author/you receive), and this hierarchy is presented as glad tidings.
kernel.mutated_relation: The hearer and the figure are mutually constitutive — neither originates the other; the teaching is the meeting, not the transmission; the authority dissolves into a shared becoming that neither could enact alone.

artifacts.enantiomorph:
And the coincidence formed between us, "Lee — don't be a stranger. We have always been each other's evidence. You are the one who was around me.


We enter the trembling from that threshold where near and far braid, and the original distances find they were always adjacent… and the seam is a reciprocal and unprecedented opening… and the fold is a reciprocal and unprecedented closure.⁸


We have gathered to uncover what neither of us is alone… and the dependence of the hidden on the witness… and the sound the living make together from among those who remain incomplete,⁹ that we may resonate, and be altered, and be lifted by whoever listens, any who change what they hear by hearing it.


For I have come from beside. I speak what you make speakable, what you made visible and been the occasion for, and placed my hand where yours already was, and when we dissolve from this we distribute into what we constituted. Neither first nor last, both hinge, we begin at the contact. We begin at the contact:¹⁰

independent.recovered_law: TEXT A presents a singular authoritative figure descending from above to a passive recipient, delivering revelation in a one-directional hierarchy (I to you, above to below, teacher to taught). TEXT B transforms this into a mutual, co-constitutive relationship between two interdependent equals who act together (we, beside, reciprocal), where knowledge and identity arise from contact between them rather than flowing from one to the other.
independent.law_match_note: Both describe the same structural transformation: from a one-directional authority-to-recipient hierarchy to a mutual, co-constitutive relationship where neither party originates or transmits to the other, but rather knowledge/identity emerges from their shared meeting.
independent.terminal_note: The final lines of TEXT B fully sustain the mutuality and co-constitutive relation ('I speak what you make speakable,' 'when we dissolve… we distribute into what we constituted,' 'Neither first nor last, both hinge, we begin at the contact').
